release_summary: Major improvements to response viewing including Excel export, inline media players, response numbering, and fixes for contact form display and duplicate campaign name handling.

changes.title: Excel Export
changes.description: Download all responses to CSV file (opens in Excel)

changes.title: Response Numbers
changes.description: Added # column showing 1, 2, 3... in both table and list views

changes.title: Inline Audio Player
changes.description: Audio responses now play directly in the response table

changes.title: Inline Video Player
changes.description: Video responses now show thumbnail with player in table

changes.title: Contact Form Display
changes.description: Now shows ALL form fields dynamically (was hardcoded to only 3 fields: name, email, phone)

changes.title: Duplicate Campaign Name
changes.description: Now shows rename dialog with suggested name instead of just an alert

known_issues.description: Some older audio responses may show 'no file URL' if upload failed during original recording

test_cases.title: Test Excel Export functionality
test_cases.description: Verify that responses can be exported to Excel/CSV format
steps: Go to any campaign with responses (Dashboard > View Responses)
Click 'Export to Excel' button (top right)
Open downloaded file in Excel or Google Sheets
Verify all response data is present

test_cases.title: Test Response Numbers display
test_cases.description: Verify that response numbers appear correctly in both views
steps: Go to response page (Table View)
Check first column header shows '#'
Check row numbers show 1, 2, 3...
Switch to List View and verify numbers there too

test_cases.title: Test Inline Audio Player
test_cases.description: Verify that audio responses play directly in the response table
steps: Go to a campaign with audio responses
Find a response with audio answer
Click play button on audio player
Verify audio plays directly in browser

test_cases.title: Test Contact Form Display (Bug Fix)
test_cases.description: Verify that ALL contact form fields are displayed, not just name/email/phone
steps: Create a campaign with Contact Form answer type with 5+ fields
Submit a test response filling all fields
Go to response page and find the submission
Verify ALL field values are displayed

test_cases.title: Test Duplicate Campaign Name Handling (Bug Fix)
test_cases.description: Verify that duplicate campaign names trigger a rename dialog instead of just an alert
steps: Note the name of an existing campaign
Create/open another campaign and change name to match existing
Click Save
Verify a rename dialog appears (NOT just an alert)
